reviews.text:
I revisited the cat cafe because I found a favorite cat.
The staff member didn't seem to know about the subscription service!? They kept scrolling through the subscription screen on their phone and clacking away on their computer for ages.😅
The only thing they said confidently was, "It's only 350 yen, right?"
At the Coolik Plus store, you need to pay 350 yen for the free drinks, but this store isn't included in that.😡
They didn't even know where the reserved toys were, wandering around aimlessly until I had to explain.🥲
Because of that, I felt a little uneasy and deducted one point.
If they didn't know, I wish they had asked the other staff member instead of wasting so much time.😓
The cats were cute, even the ones I didn't like.😊

The store smelled awful and was poorly maintained.

The staff seemed unmotivated, so I left immediately.
I went to a cat cafe! The cats were so friendly and I felt so relaxed. 🐱 The staff were also friendly and fun. …

I came here to pick up a live animal. The store was very clean, and I was able to get a good deal by using Premium40. The staff were very polite and I was able to consult with them with peace of mind, and I was able to welcome them into my family.

Hello. I'm going on vacation in February from Mexico City. Do you sell puppies? Can you provide the necessary documentation required by the airline to bring one to my country? It's a gift for my daughter.

I visited to purchase some products. The staff were very polite and helpful, making me feel comfortable shopping even though it was my first visit. Be aware of their break time from 1:30 PM to 2:00 PM, but they were able to assist me immediately afterward. I'm considering using their subscription service next time, as it offers great savings.

I went to a cat cafe. The cafe was quiet during breaks, and the cats were relaxed. I was impressed by how the staff listened to my questions and patiently answered all my inquiries about cats. I tried the Premium 40 plan, and I was able to spend a long time with the cats, and it felt like a good deal. I recommend it to anyone who wants to interact with cats. Each cat has its own personality, and they are all adorable.
The prices were reasonable, and it was easy to use for my first time at a cat cafe.

I had a wonderful time!

The cats were adorable too.

Thank you very much for your continued patronage.

We look forward to serving you again.

We appreciate your continued support of Coo&RIKU.

The shop was very clean, and cute cats were playing freely. The staff were also kind, creating an atmosphere that made me feel like I was spending time with family. I felt soothed and warmed by spending time interacting with the cats. There are break times, so I recommend checking in advance. I was able to enjoy a relaxing time and completely lost track of time.
The cats are very friendly, love to play, and are incredibly cute. Using the subscription service is a great deal. The staff were also kind, and it was a very comfortable place to be.
I was soothed by all the cute cats ^ ^

I recently had a very relaxing experience at a cat cafe. I'm happy that I found a new favorite cat while interacting with the adorable felines. The cafe has a relaxing atmosphere, and the cats are very friendly. If you visit outside of lunchtime, you can enjoy it at your leisure. They also have a subscription service, which makes me want to visit regularly. It's easily accessible, and I definitely want to return.

The shop is clean and has a calm atmosphere, and the prices are reasonable, making it easy to visit regularly. The staff were polite and attentive, which made me feel at ease even on my first visit. Being soothed by the cute cats and finding a favorite was a wonderful experience.
Utterly awful place. Cats caged in tiny glass cages. Saw them clawing to get out. No hiding spaces, just stuck in a glass container. Absolutely horrendous. This should be banned.

When I asked about taking the animals out of the cage the clerk told me that the animals would need vaccinations before taking them to the airport. She had just assumed that I was a tourist. After I continued to inquire about playing with the animals outside of the cages she told me I could go to a pet cafe. Who buys a pet without holding them first? She acted like the animals were decorative lamps that I would buy based upon looks and  only touching them while a staff member held them. The presumptions about me and the restrictions made me feel very unwelcome.

It’s inhumane to keep animals in those small cages
Please at least let them socialize together!

Thank you very much for your continued patronage.

We look forward to serving you again.

We appreciate your continued support of Coo&RIKU.

I visited the attached cat cafe for the first time. The female staff member's explanation felt insufficient, but I bought some treats and went upstairs. First, I was puzzled by the lack of a handwashing station upon entering. Is it okay to touch the cats with dirty hands? Come to think of it, there was no explanation about handwashing or sanitizing... Upon opening the door, a foul odor filled the air, and upon inspection, feces were scattered next to the toilet.

There were no lockers with locks, and the slippers and cat-related items were tattered, which bothered me.

As others have mentioned, the cats were very eager for the treats, fighting over them; they seemed very hungry. Many of the cats appeared thin.

All the cats were cute and let me pet them (^^), but they kept meowing anxiously, wanting to be held, and seemed starved for affection...

Even though the price is cheaper and easier to use than other cat cafes, given this condition, I would rather pay a little more to contribute to the cats' well-being. While I understand that the first floor is a pet shop and they have to handle that, the absence of staff in the cafe felt strange. They should pay more attention to the cats.

Despite numerous scathing reviews, the fact that no improvements have been made is unacceptable!!!

It was absolutely awful.
I used the cat cafe on the second floor, but the stench was terrible the moment I entered. There was cat feces left unattended near the toilet at the back. I gave the cats treats, but the way they all gobbled them up made me think they probably weren't getting enough food.
Even though the cats were crying anxiously the whole time, there seemed to be only one staff member, who never came up to the second floor. The slippers were tattered, showing that they really weren't taking care of the place.
I sincerely hope that pet shops and animal cafes like this disappear from the world, and that more animals can live happily.

Thank you very much for your continued patronage.

We look forward to serving you again.

We appreciate your continued support of Coo&RIKU.

Very dirty and unhygienic. Extremely rude staff. Entry fee included “drinks”. In the cat section was a fridge, with drinks in it, and a sign saying “do not take”. When I asked after/upon paying where the drinks were then, the shop assistant simply pointed upstairs. 🤷‍♀️ …

Thank you very much for your continued patronage.

We look forward to serving you again. … More
There all in tiny cages very inhumane
We welcomed two family members from here.

I bought a dog here, and it was a terrible experience.

Be careful with the "peace of mind package." …
The cat we adopted from this store on January 7th suddenly died of FIP on March 17th. …

Great shop! The shopkeeper let us pet cats and dogs. All very cute! All the animals  are well taken care of.
Must visit if in akasaka!
